title: 无畸变线：所有频率走得一样快、衰减一样多
statement: 一条加感电话线长 100 km，原参数：R_0 = 6 Ω/km，L_0 = 60 mH/km，G_0 = 0.5 µS/km，C_0 = 5 nF/km。始端电压 U̇_1 = 10∠0° V（有效值，f = 1 kHz），终端接 R_L = 3464.1 Ω。
x 从始端量起。（图上只标了线长，原参数见题干。）

questions.ask: 特性阻抗 Z_c 的模 = ?

questions.explain: Z_0/Y_0 = L_0(R_0/L_0 + jω)/[C_0(G_0/C_0 + jω)] = L_0/C_0，是正实数，所以 Z_c 是纯电阻，辐角 0°。

questions.ask: f = 1 kHz 时的相速 v = ?
f = 3 kHz 时的相速 v = ?
questions.explain: β = ω√(L_0C_0) 与 ω 成正比，所以 v = ω/β 不随频率变化——各频率分量同时到达，波形不畸变。

questions.ask: 终端接匹配负载 R_L = Z_c，始端 U_1 = 10 V，终端电压 U_2 = ?
questions.explain: 匹配时 U_2 = U_1·e^{−αl} = 10 × e^{−0.1732} = 8.41 V；各频率衰减相同，所以只缩小、不变形。

hints: 先检查 R_0/L_0 和 G_0/C_0：两者相等就是无畸变线。
满足条件时 Z_0 = L_0(R_0/L_0 + jω)、Y_0 = C_0(G_0/C_0 + jω) 只差一个常数倍，Z_c 和 γ 都可以直接开方。
γ = √(R_0G_0) + jω√(L_0C_0)：α 与频率无关，β 与频率成正比。
solution: **检查：** αl = 1.732×10⁻³ × 100 = 0.1732 Np；β(1 kHz) = 2π × 1000/57735 = 0.1088 rad/km，λ = 2π/β = 57.7 km = v/f ✓。普通电话线 L_0 太小（R_0/L_0 ≫ G_0/C_0），所以要在线上串加感线圈（加感），使它接近无畸变条件。

en.title: Distortionless line: every frequency travels equally fast and is attenuated equally
statement: A loaded telephone line is 100 km long with the primary parameters R_0 = 6 Ω/km, L_0 = 60 mH/km, G_0 = 0.5 µS/km, C_0 = 5 nF/km. The start voltage is U̇_1 = 10∠0° V (rms, f = 1 kHz) and the end is loaded with R_L = 3464.1 Ω.
x is measured from the start. (The drawing shows only the length; the primary parameters are given here.)

questions.ask: Magnitude of the characteristic impedance Z_c = ?
questions.explain: R_0/L_0 = 6/0.06 = 100 s⁻¹ and G_0/C_0 = 0.5×10⁻⁶/5×10⁻⁹ = 100 s⁻¹: the distortionless condition holds, Z_c = √(L_0/C_0) = √(0.06/5×10⁻⁹) = 3464 Ω.
Z_0/Y_0 = L_0(R_0/L_0 + jω)/[C_0(G_0/C_0 + jω)] = L_0/C_0, a positive real number, so Z_c is purely resistive: angle 0°.
Distortionless line: γ = √(R_0G_0) + jω√(L_0C_0), so α = √(6 × 0.5×10⁻⁶) = 1.732×10⁻³ Np/km, independent of frequency.

questions.ask: Phase velocity at f = 1 kHz, v = ?
Phase velocity at f = 3 kHz, v = ?
questions.explain: β = ω√(L_0C_0) is proportional to ω, so v = ω/β does not change with frequency — all frequency components arrive together and the waveform is not distorted.

questions.ask: With the matched load R_L = Z_c and U_1 = 10 V, the end voltage U_2 = ?
questions.explain: Matched: U_2 = U_1·e^{−αl} = 10 × e^{−0.1732} = 8.41 V; every frequency is attenuated alike, so the signal shrinks without changing shape.

hints: Compare R_0/L_0 with G_0/C_0 first: if they are equal the line is distortionless.
Then Z_0 = L_0(R_0/L_0 + jω) and Y_0 = C_0(G_0/C_0 + jω) differ only by a constant factor, so Z_c and γ can be square-rooted directly.
γ = √(R_0G_0) + jω√(L_0C_0): α does not depend on frequency, β is proportional to it.
solution: **2. Characteristic impedance.** Z_c = √(L_0/C_0) = **3464 Ω**, purely resistive (angle **0°**) and independent of frequency.
**3. Propagation constant.** α = √(R_0G_0) = **1.732×10⁻³ Np/km**; β = ω√(L_0C_0), v = 1/√(L_0C_0) = **57735 km/s**, the same at 1 kHz and 3 kHz.
**4. Matched load.** R_L = Z_c, only the incident wave: U_2 = 10 × e^{−0.1732} = **8.41 V**.

**Check:** αl = 1.732×10⁻³ × 100 = 0.1732 Np; β(1 kHz) = 2π × 1000/57735 = 0.1088 rad/km, λ = 2π/β = 57.7 km = v/f ✓. An ordinary telephone pair has far too little L_0 (R_0/L_0 ≫ G_0/C_0), which is why loading coils were inserted in series to approach the distortionless condition.
